text: The authors propose semi-supervised reinforcement learning as one framework for thinking about how to exploit a limited oversight budget more efficiently, for example by combining limited calls to the true objective function with frequent calls to an imperfect proxy: like ordinary RL, except the agent sees its reward only on a small fraction of timesteps or episodes, while its performance is still evaluated on reward from all episodes.
title: Semi-supervised reinforcement learning as a framework for using a limited oversight budget
